question: Related Questions Q. What are the rulings of having walima? How soon after the meeting of the bride & groom should walima be held? 14853 views Q. I did not share this (she loves someone else and talaq matter) with her parents. Few days before she went to her sister?s house and said to her parents that I have given talaq to her 3 to 4 times. Those people came to my house and beat me and blamed my sister that she has spoiled their daughter?s life. She lie a lot (even takes oath on Quran). While getting married I was told my many people who know her family that they strictly follow Islam. But now I know that they are not. Her father had died few years back before my marriage. She has taken all jewelry give by us. I do not want to spend rest of my life with a liar who does not fear Allah and the Day of Judgment. Please help me. In eleven months of our marriage she hardly stayed with me for 2 months. Please let me know what will be compensation I should give? Will I get back the jewelry (not mahar) give by me? I think, i do not know about sex life how to amuse wife. So sometimes, i watch sketc drawing/ still photos/cartoon/3-d animations of sexual intercourse with a view to learning it and amusing my future wife. Is it a sin ? If yes, how can i learn it? Question: Assalamu alaikum. I am a young man of 34 years. Unmarried but looking for a bride. Very soon, i will marry inshallah. I think, i do not know about sex life how to amuse wife. So sometimes, i watch sketc drawing/ still photos/cartoon/3-d animations of sexual intercourse with a view to learning it and amusing my future wife. Is it a sin ? If yes, how can i learn it? Answer ID: 7173 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1583/1350=B/1429) Yes, it is sin. You can achieve these things by study of any decent and proper book. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
